description: This file defines the internal lexer class for handling Smarty configuration files, including token definitions, patterns, and lexing logic for parsing configuration files within the Smarty template engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Configfilelexer
classes.description: Lexer class for PHP Smarty configuration files, responsible for tokenizing source input based on pattern matching and managing lexer states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lexer with source data and compiler context, setting up patterns and initial state.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces input string patterns; here it returns the input unchanged.

methods.name: PrintTrace
methods.description: Initializes trace output for lexer debugging.

methods.name: yylex
methods.description: Dispatches lexing based on current state.

methods.name: yypushstate
methods.description: Pushes a new state onto the lexer state stack, optionally tracing the action.

methods.name: yypopstate
methods.description: Pops the current lexer state from the stack, optionally tracing the action.

methods.name: yybegin
methods.description: Sets the current lexer state directly.

methods.name: yylex1
methods.description: Lexes tokens for state 1 based on predefined regex pattern.

methods.name: yy_r1_*
methods.description: Functions to handle specific regex match outcomes in state 1, setting token types and changing states.
